name: Off-Highway Recreational Vehicle
description: A vehicle built for off-highway recreation: an ATV, a side-by-side, a snowmobile, or a motorcycle designed for off-highway use that can't be registered as a motorcycle, commonly known as a dirt bike. An off-road electric dirt bike lands here. Defined by Maryland Transportation Article §11-140.1.
restrictions: Includes a motorcycle designed for off-highway operation that isn't eligible for registration as a Class D (motorcycle) vehicle, with no limit on power or speed
One bought on or after October 1, 2010 must be titled with the MVA, applying electronically
Can't be registered for the road, so it may not be driven on a highway
